description: Teach practical adult skills often missing from formal education.
notes: Kit fallback inlined; shared kit.js not present at build time

notes.note: Schools don't teach pay stubs, leases, or credit scores, and young adults learn by expensive mistake — the tap-any-line plain-English lesson is a great format. The B2B2C path (employers/colleges onboarding young hires at $4/seat) is real distribution with real budgets. One of the few edtech ideas here with a buyer.
Pay-stub module + 4-question quiz with per-question feedback and score screen verified; zero errors. Fixed header overlap.

notes.change: Built the Credit module: tappable FICO factor explorer plus a live score simulator (balance/lates/history sliders).
